title: feat(ui): place DXF profiles on the stock from the Stock page and a drop
body:
## What changed

This PR adds the UI for DXF profiles over the #1862 commands (`ImportDxf`, `MoveSketch`, `DeleteEntity`). It follows the maintainer's scope change on the issue: the DXF door is on the Stock page, not on `Model > Open`.

- The Stock page has a new group "DXF profiles". It has the control "Add DXF profile…" (a `.dxf` file picker). The control is disabled when the active setup has no stock.
- The group lists each profile of the active setup with these controls:
  - "Profile X", "Profile Y" and "Profile angle (deg)". These are a draft. "Place profile" queues one `MoveSketch`.
  - "Hide profile" / "Show profile". This is view state, the same list as the browser eye.
  - "Delete profile". This queues one `DeleteEntity`.
- A `.dxf` file dropped on the viewport goes through the same import path. With no stock, the drop is refused by name: "drop refused: <file> is a DXF profile - make a stock first ...".
- A drawing without `$INSUNITS` opens the modal "DXF units". The modal shows the drawing size read in millimeters and read in inches, each with the size in the other unit. "Millimeters" or "Inches" runs `ImportDxf` with that unit. "Cancel", Escape or a backdrop click places nothing. The unit is never guessed.
- The status line shows the import summary: the name, the setup, the unit and its source (file or chosen), the layer count, the closed and open chain counts, the chains not chained, and the skipped entities by type.
- The browser shows each profile as a child row of its setup's Stock row (`Leaf::Sketch`), with the suffix "DXF profile" and the eye. A click opens the Stock page and selects the profile, so Del deletes it through the history.
- The viewport draws the profile lines, arcs and circles of the active setup on the stock top, at `sketch::world_pose`. Each free end of an open chain gets a magenta X. No curve uses that colour, so an open gap does not look closed.
- The overlay lines are cached by the sketch data `Arc` and the pose (`SketchLineCache` on `FrameCache`). A still frame builds nothing (crates/ui/AGENTS.md, frame cost).
- The operation page Source list offers the profiles of the operation's setup for a kind that `sketch_model::admits` (2D milling, plasma, wire EDM). A setup with a stock, a profile and no model can so have an operation on the profile.
- `camcraft_app` re-exports `camcraft_geometry::dxf`, so the UI can name the `Primitive` variants. This adds no crate dependency.

The import does not use `finish_import`. That function handles the model worker. `ImportDxf` checks the drawing at construction, so the typed `DxfUnitsMissing` error is caught where the UI builds the command. `docs/decisions/1863-dxf-stock-ui.md` records this and the other choices.

## Cause

The #1862 commands had no UI door. A user could place a DXF profile only through MCP or the script.

## Tests

New pins in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/dxf_profile.rs`:

- `the_stock_page_adds_lists_places_and_deletes_a_dxf_profile`
- `a_drawing_without_units_asks_millimeters_or_inches_and_never_guesses`
- `a_dropped_dxf_lands_on_the_stock_or_asks_for_one`
- `the_browser_lists_the_profile_under_its_stock_with_an_eye`
- `the_viewport_draws_the_chains_on_the_stock_top_and_marks_open_ends`
- `the_operation_page_takes_the_profile_as_its_source_without_a_model`
- `a_still_frame_builds_no_profile_lines_and_a_move_builds_once`

Also:

- `page_layout_windows::layout_window_dxf_units` (the named layout test of the new modal).
- `dxf_units_dialog::tests::readings_state_both_units_both_ways`.
- `dxf_drop::tests::dxf_by_extension_in_any_case`.

Red before the fix: yes. On upstream/main the pins do not compile. `CommandKind::ImportDxf`, `CommandKind::MoveSketch`, `State::dxf_units_prompt`, `Leaf::Sketch`, `sketch_overlay` and `op_source` do not exist.

Mutation checks (each red with the mutation, green when restored):

- Guess millimeters for a drawing without units: `a_drawing_without_units...` is red ("nothing lands before the answer").
- Remove the stock check of the drop: `a_dropped_dxf...` is red (the refusal does not name the file).
- Remove the profiles from the Source list: `the_operation_page...` is red.
- Draw a hidden profile: `the_viewport_draws...` is red.
- Bypass the line cache: `a_still_frame_builds...` is red.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green on `4543f6207be39f2222ad0de0194f469c3296c309` (20 steps, 0 failed: app lib, ui lib and 17 ui suites). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

## Goldens moved

None. No posted G-code, CL file or snapshot PNG changes.

## Not exercised

- Before and after screenshots are attached below. The captures use the real offscreen renderer. The structural tests pin the labels, the rows and the overlay vertices.
- A `.dxf` dropped in the browser build (wasm) is refused by name. The browser drop path delivers model bytes only.
- The native file picker of "Add DXF profile…" is not driven in a test. The test calls the same `CommandKind::ImportDxf`.

## Overlaps

These open PRs touch the same files, in different functions. The PR that merges second refreshes.

- `crates/ui/src/state.rs`: #2999, #2993, #2992, #2981, #2979, #2978, #2974, #2972, #2969, #2968, #2964, #2955, #2951, #2786, #2773, #2763, #2932. This PR adds enum variants, two fields and four dispatch arms only.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/stock_page.rs`: #2773 (stock axis). This PR adds one line in `stock_page`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/browser_tree.rs`: #2714. This PR adds a variant to `Leaf` and rows in `setup_children`.
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs`: #2932 (a constant). This PR adds one line in `collect_overlay`.
- `crates/ui/src/operations.rs` is not changed.

Changelog: The Stock page places a DXF profile on the stock top ("Add DXF profile…", or drop a `.dxf` on the viewport), asks for the unit when the drawing states none, lists and places profiles, shows them in the browser and on the stock with open chain ends marked, and offers them as the Source of 2D, plasma and wire EDM operations.

## Review fixes

Final source head: `4543f6207be39f2222ad0de0194f469c3296c309`.

Base (`upstream/main`): `2d98d87be18d0711630e6d824b2ccb0dd90e66a4`.

Reached heavy lane: `app heavy` (all targets, triggered by `crates/app/src/lib.rs`).

- The profile cache keeps every visible profile. It removes entries when their data or pose leaves the visible set.
- `more_than_32_visible_profiles_build_nothing_on_a_still_frame` imports 33 distinct profiles. The next unchanged draw adds zero builds. It also checks that a move rebuilds only the changed profile.
- Mutation check: restoring the 32-entry FIFO makes the new test fail (66 builds instead of 33). Restoring the fix makes the test pass.
- The merge of `upstream/main` retains the DXF profile cache and the ground shadow cache in `FrameCache`.
- Screenshots are stored only on the fork’s images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Both images were inspected.

Before: the Stock page without the DXF group, as on `upstream/main`.

![Stock page before DXF profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/5ada40b06103b1fcad56850b33a8456768a9e94f/pr-3057/9a505f40e/before-stock.png)

After: the Stock page after import, with the profile row, placement controls, cyan curves, and magenta open ends.

![Stock page after DXF profile import](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/5ada40b06103b1fcad56850b33a8456768a9e94f/pr-3057/9a505f40e/after-dxf-profile.png)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green on the final source head, 20 steps, 0 failed (10.4 minutes).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: passed on the final source head (49.9 minutes, 203 steps, 0 failed). This includes the release build and `doc`.
- Executed ignored tests: 43 passed across 20 `app heavy` suites, plus 4 expected known-fail steps (#1950, #2849). The remaining targets had 0 ignored tests.
- Heavy suites and results: `adaptive_fig8_crossing` (2), `adaptive_pinch` (1), `carried_engine_agreement` (1), `example_catalog` (2), `feature_pick_wire` (1), `import_solidcraft` (3), `large_models` (1), `lathe_field_sim` (1), `lathe_workholding_kinds` (1), `operations` (6), `pick_agnostic` (2), `pocket3d_hsm` (1, plus 1 expected known-fail `#1950`), `rotary_field_parity` (6), `shared_face_bodies_finish` (6), `shoulder_adaptive` (1, plus 1 expected known-fail `#2849`), `stock_engine_agreement` (3), `stock_field_cost` (1), `stock_play_precalc` (1), `verify` (2), `whole_model_pocket` (1), and `lead_approach` (2 expected known-fail `#2849` steps).

Fixes #1863
